name: ai-law-counsel
description: AI-powered Korean legal consultation chatbot. Searches statutes, precedents & admin rules via National Law Information Center API with LLM function calling + SSE streaming.

paragraphs: AI-powered legal Q&A built on Korean National Law Information Center API + LLM function calling via MCP.

Ask any legal question in Korean. The AI searches relevant statutes, precedents, and administrative rules in real time, then responds with verifiable, clickable citations. Upload contracts for risk analysis or generate legal document drafts through guided Q&A.
features: Real-time legal search -- statutes, precedents, and administrative rules via National Law Information Center

Autonomous function calling -- LLM picks and chains tools (up to 8 rounds, 150s tool budget) without manual tool selection; if it stops with only a plan or hits a limit, a final no-tool synthesis turn always produces a…
MCP integration -- legal tools served by korean-law-mcp (Model Context Protocol). Host is configurable via MCPBASEURL (defaults to production uses self-hosted HF Space
SSE streaming -- token-by-token response for natural reading
Conversation history -- persisted in browser, sidebar navigation, context windowing (last 10 turns)
